notes: Sign-in itself needs a password, so the harness uses each person's demo session. The app opens in the browser's language (the URL decides; next-intl negotiates it): the Member's stored language 'ar' only sets the language of their emails (apps/web/src/lib/browser-locale.ts, data-model member_notification_preference). The plan's expectation 'Arabic from sign-in' holds only for an Arabic browser.
